title: What If You Raced a Cheetah? Even Usain Bolt Loses
subject: cheetah

scenes.text: What if you raced a cheetah? Even the fastest human ever would not be close.
Usain Bolt's fastest stretch was about 28 miles an hour, during his 9.58 second world record.
Wild cheetahs tracked with GPS collars in Botswana hit 58 miles an hour.
At that speed a cheetah covers 100 meters in under four seconds. Bolt needed 9.58.
Pound for pound, its acceleration power is about four times Bolt's in his world record run.
And it rarely uses top speed. Most hunts are slower. The race was over before the start.
